title: The PSLRA’s strong-inference requirement
summary: The Private Securities Litigation Reform Act imposes a heightened pleading requirement concerning scienter, the legally required wrongful state of mind, in the securities setting addressed by Tellabs.
notes: This is a specialized statutory requirement. It should not be applied automatically to every Rule 8 claim.

sections.Meaning: The Private Securities Litigation Reform Act imposes a heightened pleading requirement concerning scienter, the legally required wrongful state of mind, in the securities setting addressed by Tellabs.
sections.How to work through the question: Evaluate the allegations collectively and compare the proposed inference with plausible nonculpable explanations. Under Tellabs, the inference must be cogent and at least as compelling as the competing inference.
